name: Sakura Sweetheart
source:
Let Marron narrate her story of how she fell in love with Zakuro, the head chef of a mansion. Can Marron melt Zakuro’s heart like chocolate? Find out in the little yuri love story.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/sakura-is-for-24810919]Winged Cloud's Patreon[/url]]
translation:
让玛伦讲述她如何爱上豪宅主厨扎九郎的故事。马龙能像巧克力一样融化扎九郎的心吗？在小尤里的爱情故事中找到答案。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/sakura-is-for-24810919]Winged Cloud的Patreon[/url]]
